create=$(printf 'post-reboot-create\n' | curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$base/post-reboot-check.txt")
replace=$(printf 'post-reboot-replace\n' | curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$base/post-reboot-check.txt")
readback=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" "$base/post-reboot-check.txt")
deleted=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE "$base/post-reboot-check.txt")
cat > "$xml" <<'LOCK_EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?>
<D:lockinfo xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:lockscope><D:exclusive/></D:lockscope><D:locktype><D:write/></D:locktype><D:owner><D:href>editor</D:href></D:owner></D:lockinfo>
LOCK_EOF
printf 'locked-original\n' | curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -X PUT --data-binary @- "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt"
lock_code=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -D "$hdr" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X LOCK -H 'Timeout: Second-300' -H 'Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8' --data-binary @"$xml" "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
token=[REDACTED]]] 'tolower($1)=="lock-token:[REDACTED]]]\r",""); print $2}' "$hdr")
[ -n "$token" ]
blocked=$(printf 'forbidden-overwrite\n' | curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT --data-binary @- "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
locked_content=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
accepted=$(printf 'accepted-overwrite\n' | curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "If: ($token)" --data-binary @- "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
unlocked=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X UNLOCK -H "Lock-Token: [REDACTED]]] "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
lock_deleted=$(curl -sS -u "$user:$pass" -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X DELETE "$base/post-reboot-lock.txt")
printf 'post_restart_access anonymous=%s editor=%s\n' "$anon" "$auth"
printf 'post_restart_CRUD create=%s replace=%s readback_ok=%s delete=%s\n' "$create" "$replace" "$([ "$readback" = post-reboot-replace ] && printf yes || printf no)" "$deleted"
printf 'post_restart_lock lock=%s no_token_update=[REDACTED]]] content_preserved=%s token_update=[REDACTED]]] unlock=%s cleanup_delete=%s\n' "$lock_code" "$blocked" "$([ "$locked_content" = locked-original ] && printf yes || printf no)" "$accepted" "$unlocked" "$lock_deleted"
[ "$anon" = 401 ] && [ "$auth" = 200 ]
[ "$create" = 201 ] && [ "$replace" = 204 ] && [ "$readback" = post-reboot-replace ] && [ "$deleted" = 204 ]
[ "$lock_code" = 200 ] && [ "$blocked" = 423 ] && [ "$locked_content" = locked-original ] && [ "$accepted" = 204 ] && [ "$unlocked" = 204 ] && [ "$lock_deleted" = 204 ]
